require

The module is introduced and the interface is returned through module.exports.

Parameter

Name Type Description
path String The relative path of the module file relative to the current file, or the name of the npm module, or the path of the npm module needs to be imported. Absolute paths are not supported.

Sample Code

// common.js
function sayHello(name) {
  console.log(`Hello ${name} !`)
}
function sayGoodbye(name) {
  console.log(`Goodbye ${name} !`)
}

module.exports.sayHello = sayHello
module.exports.sayGoodbye = sayGoodbye

var common = require('common.js')
Page({
  helloMacle: function() {
    common.sayHello('Macle')
  },
  goodbyeMacle: function() {
    common.sayGoodbye('Macle')
  }
})
